svg.title: linear-ssd
svg.desc: Mamba-2 written as masked attention. Left: the 8×8 mask L with L_tj = a_(j+1)…a_t for toy decays a_t = 0.9, 0.2, 0.95, 0.95, 0.9, 0.5, 0.95; the small a_3 = 0.2 cuts every path that crosses token 3. Middle: dictionary x↔v, B↔k, C↔q, N↔d_k, P↔d_v. Right: Nemotron 3 Nano numbers: 64 heads of 64×128 state = 524,288 numbers per Mamba-2 layer, 8 B/C groups, chunk 128, and 23 Mamba-2 + 23 MoE + 6 attention layers.

text.font-family: STIX Two Math,Cambria Math,Times New Roman,serif

svg.text: St = at St-1 + Δt xt Bt ⊤ , yt = St Ct ⇔ Y = (L ∘ CB⊤ )(ΔX)

svg.text: n_groups = 8: B, C shared by 8 heads (GQA-like)
one decay scalar per head per token
decode cache = fixed SSM state + KV of 6 layers
ΔX: row t of X scaled by its step size Δ. Mamba-1 decays each (channel, state) entry separately: no matmul form.
